title: Add KV-cache eviction and cold-start tracepoints to console route metrics (incident follow-up)
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Post-incident follow-up: During a capacity-triggered regression on 2026-02-15, tenant-level cold-start tail latency spikes and KV-cache eviction activity were not visible in our Console dashboards or traces. The missing telemetry delayed alerting and root-cause identification by ~90 minutes. This ticket captures the work to add missing metrics, new tracepoints, dashboard updates, and follow-up automation.
impact_summary: High: delayed detection of tenant-facing latency spikes; operators lacked per-tenant eviction visibility leading to manual investigation time and customer impact for ~2 customers.
observed_problem: No instrumented metric for 'kv_cache.evictions_total' exported at request-path boundaries; tracespan for 'runtime.kv.cache.miss' missing for cold-start requests routed through smart-routing; dashboards aggregated at global rather than route/tenant granularity.
root_cause_analysis: Instrumentation gaps: runtime previously only emitted eviction stats to internal process logs and a single host-level metric. Smart-routing introduced new fast-path that bypassed the existing trace wrapper for cold-starts. Dashboard templates were written prior to per-route tagging and rely on host-level aggregates.
decisions: 1) Add three new metrics with per-route and tenant tags: kv_cache.evictions_total, kv_cache.eviction_latency_ms_p50/p95. 2) Introduce trace spans for cold-start and cache-miss on smart-routing fast-path. 3) Update console dashboards to use per-route rollups and add synthetic alerts. 4) Backfill missing data via short-term agent that parses historical logs for evictions.
action_items: Add metric kv_cache.evictions_total with tags [tenant_id, route, model_variant] and export via metrics-pusher (owner: Marco Velasquez, estimate: 2, due: 2026-03-10)
Add histogram metrics kv_cache.eviction_latency_ms_p50 and _p95 (owner: Linh Tran, estimate: 3, due: 2026-03-12)
Instrument smart-routing fast-path with trace spans: runtime.kv.cache.miss and runtime.cold_start (owner: Priya Nair, estimate: 3, due: 2026-03-08)
Update Console dashboards: per-route eviction heatmap, tenant-tail-latency overlay, and add alerting rules (owner: Jordan Smith, estimate: 2, due: 2026-03-15)
Create log-parsing job to backfill eviction events for last 30 days into metric store (owner: Marco Velasquez, estimate: 3, due: 2026-03-20)
Add automated SLO regression test that triggers a synthetic cold-start and validates metric emission and alerting (owner: Reliability WG, estimate: 5, due: 2026-04-01)
